train_reward_model: train a reward model using binary cross entropy on trajectory preference pairs from a dataset
validate_reward_model: validate the reward model on a validation set and log accuracy and loss metrics
save_checkpoint: save the reward model checkpoint, optimizer state, and training metrics to disk
get_all_messages: extract and sort all training messages from the dataset loader for RMS calculation
get_rms: calculate the running mean and standard deviation of rewards across the training dataset
